### Tropicana Atlantic City to Celebrate Grand Opening of The Lounge Tattoo Co. on Friday, Nov. 13


11/09/2026


[Download this Press Release (opens in new window) DOCX](https://s202.q4cdn.com/508919455/files/doc_news/2026/Nov/09/202610_TAC_The-Lounge-Tattoo-Co-Press-Release.docx)


***Established South Jersey tattoo studio expands to The Quarter with ribbon cutting, Friday the 13th flash tattoo specials and a weekend celebrating tattoo artistry***


**ATLANTIC CITY, N.J. — (Nov. 9, 2026) —**[Tropicana Atlantic City](https://www.caesars.com/tropicana-ac/) is welcoming a new addition to The Quarter with the grand opening of[The Lounge Tattoo Co.](https://www.theloungetattoo.com/) , Atlantic City’s first-ever and only casino-based tattoo studio, on Friday, Nov. 13. Building on its established presence in Egg Harbor Township, New Jersey, the locally recognized tattoo studio is expanding to Atlantic City, bringing its signature artistry and elevated boutique experience to Tropicana’s premier shopping, dining and entertainment destination.


With a loyal following throughout South Jersey, The Lounge Tattoo Co. has built its reputation on quality craftsmanship, personalized service and a welcome atmosphere, attracting a diverse clientele that includes professional athletes and other notable figures. Its expansion into Tropicana marks an exciting new chapter for the local business, introducing its talented artists and creative expertise to a broader audience of resort guests and Atlantic City visitors.


The new location features a sleek, minimalist design with industrial finishes, rich charcoal tones, curated artwork and greenery. Guests can expect an inviting, boutique-style environment offering everything from smaller, meaningful tattoos to larger custom pieces, with plans to welcome guest artists and introduce exclusive designs inspired by Atlantic City.


“The Lounge Tattoo Co. has already established a strong presence in our local community, and we’re excited to welcome them to Tropicana as they continue to grow,” said Gregg Klein, senior vice president and general manager, Tropicana Atlantic City. “As Atlantic City’s first casino-based tattoo studio, The Lounge brings an entirely new experience to our resort, further expanding the variety of ways guests can enjoy their time at Tropicana.”


For The Lounge, the expansion represents an opportunity to build on its South Jersey roots while embracing the energy and excitement of Atlantic City.


“We’re incredibly excited to bring The Lounge Tattoo Co. to Tropicana and be part of something new for Atlantic City. Being the first casino-based tattoo studio is an incredible opportunity to push the industry forward, create opportunities for artists and introduce our craft to a broader audience,” said Daniel Czar, owner, The Lounge Tattoo Co. “We’re proud of the community we’ve built in South Jersey and look forward to growing it while continuing to lead with professionalism, quality artistry and an exceptional client experience.”


**Grand Opening Festivities – Friday, Nov. 13**


The Lounge Tattoo Co. will celebrate its grand opening on Friday, Nov. 13 with a reception from 3 to 5 p.m., featuring a ribbon cutting ceremony and hors d’oeuvres. **** The festivities continue from 5 to 11 p.m. as the studio embraces a longstanding Friday the 13th tattoo tradition, offering $100 flash tattoos from a selection of specially curated designs.


The celebration also coincides with the Atlantic City Tattoo Expo taking place at Tropicana Nov. 13-15, bringing together tattoo enthusiasts and artists for a weekend dedicated to the art of tattooing.


The Quarter at Tropicana is home to a dynamic collection of restaurants, retail, nightlife and entertainment. The addition of The Lounge Tattoo Co. further reflects Tropicana’s commitment to delivering more fun, value and variety through an evolving lineup of distinctive experiences for locals and visitors alike.
